messages:
alice: Heads-up: CI failing for analytics-uploader in staging after I moved ns from analytics to telemetry. Terraform applied but pods crash w/ IAM creds errors. Anyone seen IRSA annotations get dropped across namespace rename? :grimacing:

ben: Hmm—did we recreate the serviceaccount or move it? IRSA annotation is on the SA object: `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-analytics-uploader`

alice: We did a terraform rename: changed module.namespace var and ran `terraform apply` to rename k8s_namespace resource. I think we deleted+recreated in-place. Pod logs: `Failed to get credentials from projected token: token not found` and IAM assume-role failing

charu: If SA was re-created its annotation could be missing. Do you have the helm/kustomize chart that creates the SA? Sometimes helm chart has `create=true` and forgets to set `annotations` on SA.

alice: Chart: `charts/analytics-uploader/templates/serviceaccount.yaml` — it uses values.serviceAccount.annotations. Our values overlay in kustomize didn't include annotations. :( 

ben: Quick workaround: kubectl annotate ns/telemetry "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn=..." won't work — annotation must be on SA. You can patch the SA directly:

kubectl annotate sa analytics-uploader -n telemetry \
  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn="arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-analytics-uploader" --overwrite

That should restore IRSA binding for existing pods after restart.

emma: Note for Terraform fix: in k8s kubernetes_manifest / kubernetes_service_account resource, make sure `metadata.annotations` includes the iam role. Also avoid recreating SA across namespace rename; prefer moving labels rather than recreate resource. Could create lifecycle.ignore_changes for `metadata[0].annotations` during rename.

charu: Another gotcha: when SA token projection is used, `automountServiceAccountToken: false` might be set in pod spec; ensure projection is configured. Logs mention `token not found` — check projected token volume mount path and `serviceAccountName` in pod.

alice: Thanks. I'll try the patch then restart deployment. Quick Q: is it safe to add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [metadata] }` in k8s Terraform provider? I worry about drift.

ben: Use ignore_changes selectively: `ignore_changes = [metadata[0].annotations]` is OK while you're migrating. Long-term, keep annotations in IaC (helm values or kustomize overlay) so terraform doesn't lose them.

alice: Opening PR to add `serviceAccount.annotations` in kustomize overlay and a small doc in infra/runbooks about safe-namespace-moves. Assigning to me. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/1234

infra-ops-bot: deploy pipeline queued for `infra/docs` by alice — build 4567

emma: I can review the PR. Also let's add a CI check that ensures SA annotations exist for IRSA-enabled services. Maybe a simple `kubectl get sa -n {{ns}} -o yaml` grep for `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` in our smoke tests.

charu: I'll add a terraform comment about not deleting SA during namespace reparenting. 

ben: tl;dr: Patch SA, restart deployment, add annotations to kustomize, add runbook + CI check. :thumbsup:

alice: Done — patched & restarted, pods now obtain creds, ETA steady. Will follow up in PR review. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
